The initial prosecution case as stated by p.w.l, James Roy, the informant, in short,' was that deceased Jibran Tayyabi was the agency manager of Centras Maritime (BD) of which he was an employee, their office being at 69, Agrabad commercial area, Chittagong. The occurrence took place on 9.6.99. On the said date at about 5.30 p.m. Jibran Taiyyabi went out of the office in his own Car being Chattra Metro-ga- 11-1093 for his residence. Jibran himself was driving the car and when he reached at the middle place of Band box laundry and Chung king Restaurant at Sheikh Mujib Road, Agrabad, Chittagong, some one stopped his car and shot at him and then some one took him to Chittagong Medical College Hospital (hereinafter referred to as the hospital) in the said car. After Jibran Tayyabi was taken to hospital doctor there declared him dead. When the informant reached his residence at 8-10 p.m. he came to know that a person from his office informed over telephone that some one killed Jibran Tayyabi. Immediately after hearing the said information the informant went to the hospital and in the emergency ward saw Jibran dead. Jibran used to live at 5/6, Zakir Hossain Road with his wife Titli. On the next day the informant after drafting a First Information Report (FIR) went to the police station and lodged the same with Double Mooring police station. 

 20. On recall the p.w. deposed that on 28.06.1999 he filed an application before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Chittagong for taking Toyota Sidan Private Car No. Chattra Metro Ga- 11-1093 which was owned by their company. Centras Maritime Limited in his `jimma' and took the car in his 'jimma'. He further deposed that deceased Jibran Taiyyabi used to drive the seized car. He proved the jimma Nama' as exhibit 25 and his signature therein as exhibit 25/1. In further cross-examination the p.w. stated that the seized car was not brought to court. In the 'jimma nama' it was not stated from where the car was taken in the 'jimma'. 

 Sheikh Mujib Road situated by the side of Chung King Restaurant. The p.w. stated in 4, his examination-in-chief that the occurrence took place on 9.6.99, it about 5/5.15. He was present at the place of the occurrence and he saw the same. He came to his laundry at 4 p.m. on the date of the occurrence. At the time of the occurrence while a white car coming from the south reached in front of his shop a red Honda came with an accused and after stopping the said Honda in front of the car two persons stood by the two sides of 4 the car and 4 (four) others stood in front of the car with arms and then after breaking the glass of the door two persons remained standing. Jibran was sitting in the driving seat of the car. The p.w. heard the sound of two firing shots and found the man sitting in the car being shot and then the car after moving slowly stopped behind a truck. They got scared and people started coming at the place of the occurrence. Subsequently he heard that the car was taken to medical. He was examined by the police and his statements were recorded. In cross-examination the p.w. denied all the defence suggestions put to him to the effect that whatever he said in his examination-in-chief about the witnessing of the occurrence he did not say so to the investigation officer. He that he had been doing his business in the area for the last 15/16 years. He did not see whether blood of the victim poured at the place of the occurrence. He also could not say whether the broken glass of the car fell on the road. He further stated that he was in the shop sip to 9 p.m. Police came. subsequently. He could not say whether after the occurrence police seized any alamat from the place of the occurrence. He could not say when the police came. The p.w. denied the further defence suggestion that the police did not come at the place where the car was first stopped. He could not remember whether Kamal (p.w.10), Murad (p.w.4), Alamgir (p.w.3) brought the dead body in a car and then keeping the same just behind a truck shouted saying "accident accident". He pleaded his ignorance as to whether those 3 (three) persons took the dead body to the hospital and subsequently absconded. Police came to the place of the occurrence after they came to know that the deceased was an important man. He also denied the defence suggestion that he went into hiding and remained so for more than 2 (two) months. He stated that he gave statements to the investigation officer Rader Khan in his shop on 12.08.99. but he could not remember whether he gave statements to any other investigation officer. He further asserted that at the time of the occurrence he was in his shop and did not see to shot. He could not remember whether he stated to the investigating, officer that he saw to break the door of the car by stone. He denied the defence suggestion that no occurrence took place at the time and at the place as stated by him. 

 24. P.W.5 is Aleya Begum, wife of Zahid Hossain. She stated in her examination in chief that previously she used to stay at Eidgah Pur and presently she was at Mistri Para. She was a house wife. She came to Chittagong at a tender age. She married 10 years before and had 2(two) sons. One and half year before her husband had to go to jail hajat in connection with a 'maramari' case. During the absence of her husband, she being in financial crisis, Saidul of Pannapara told her to start selling heroin which would give financial solvency to both of them and accordingly, he gave her 2/3 purias of heroin. Saidul told about his friend Liakat of Mistry Para. Liakat used to purchase heroin from her. Saidul used to supply her heroin. Along with Liakat his other friends also used to come and one day he introduced one Osman to her who also used to come with his friend after a gape of 4/5 days. Osman used to sit along with his friends in the vacant room by the side of her room. Lastly  one year before, being Wednesday (the date she could not remember) Osman came with his friends to her but she told him her, inability to sell heroin any more as her Jamider forbade her. But Osman having requested her for heroin in a very humble way she gave 3(three) purias which were with her as last stock and he purchased the same. She further stated that Osman had a ‘‘যন্ত্র” which sounded "কিউ কিউ" Osman by taking the 'যন্ত্র" near his ear told to the effect "আমি আসিতেছি” and then went away; when she demanded price for the heroin Osman pushed her by her neck. At that time it was about 5/5-10 p.m. She further stated that after half an hour Osman left she heard the sound of two firing shots near Chum King Restaurant. Subsequently she heard by the by that an Indian was shot in the car. She gave statements to the investigation officer as well as to the Magistrate. She proved her left thumb impression in the statements made by her under section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (the code). The p.w. identified Osman in court and asserted that he was indebted to her taka 1,100/00. In cross-examination she stated that she gave statements to the police after two months from the date of hearing of the sound. She would not be able to state the name of 2/1 persons who knew her and she did not know the ward commissioner of her area. She after denying the defence suggestion that to the police she told the name of her husband Jahid Hossain asserted that to the police she stated the name of her husband as Zahidur Rahnian. She also asserted that to the police she gave her address being the house of Yousuf Shaudagar, Mistri Para and denied the further defence suggestion that she did not give any specific address of her before the Magistrate. She further asserted that she was at the said house till she gave statements to the police. She further stated that she could not remember whether she told the police that she went on hiding after the occurrence was published in the newspaper. She denied the further defence suggestion that she did not tell the name of Liakat to the investigation officer and she also did not tell to the police that Liakat along with his friends used to come to her for purchasing heroin. She also denied the defence suggestion that what she stated in court about Osman she did not say so to the investigating officer and she never stayed at Mistri Para and she being involved in illegal and unsocial activities deposed falsely at they instance of the police on the assurance that she would be let off from those activities. 

 25. P.W.6 is Aleya Begum @ Alo, wife of Ahmed Mia. She stated in her examination-in-chief that presently she was, staying at the house of Furkan Ali of Bagh Kunar 'মোড়’ prior to that she used to live at the house of Mofiz Khalifa of Lalkhan and before that she used to live at the house of Mr. Jainal at house No.7, Road No.5 Kulshi.  She was born in Calcutta. After her mother died in 1971 while she was aged about 3/4 years her father brought her to this country. Khan where she worked for 5(five) years and then after his son Shamsuddin Khan @ Jambu Khan got separated from A. K. Khan she used to work as the 'Bua' in the house of Jambu Khan. While she had come to work in the house of A.K. Khan, Samanja, the daughter of Jambu Khan was aged about 1/11/2 years only. 2(two) years before she gave up the job of "Bua" the said house. She further stated that there was visiting terms between the families of Jibran and Shamanja and thus intimacy grew between them. One day Shamanja went to the office of Jibran in the name of doing photocopy of a paper keeping her sitting in the car and stayed there for about 1(one) hour. On another day at about 10 p.m when Jibran came to the house of Shamanja she told him to take her to a Chinese restaurant, but she did not allow, her to go as it was late in the night but they brought soap from a Chinese restaurant in a ‘‘টিফিন বাটি” and took the some at the house and then Jibran went away- Presently Shamanja was in London and before leaving London Shamanja was in Dhaka. After 2(two) months when Emran Driver came to Chittagong he told her that Shamanja and Titu used to talk and move together the whole day. When Shamanja came back to Chittagong after slaying in Dhaka for about 2(two) 1 months Jibran started visiting her; Titu also used to visit the house of Shamanja. She further stated that when she saw that Shamanja was maintaining relationship with both of them which might have given rise to any bad incident she left the said house. And then after one year she took the job at the house of Mr. Jamal. Two police brought her to court and she gave statements there. She further stated that she was an illiterate, person and what she stated in court in her examination-in-chief she also stated so in court before. After the Magistrate wrote her statements she put her left thumb impression therein. In cross-examination by the defence the p.w. stated that police brought her from the house of Jamal at Kulshi and for the last 6(six) months she was at Baghkuna. She used to call the wife of Mr. Jamal as "মলি আপা" who had one son and one daughter. The name of the daughter was Tasmia who li was in America. She denied the defence suggestion that she did not state to the investigation officer what she stated in court in her examination-in-chief about Shamanja, Titu, Titli, Jibran and Sharafnaj. She further stated that Jibran used to go to the house of Zambu Khan with his wife and he never used to go them alone. While she was at the house of 'Mali Apa' one day police came in search of Tasmia but 'Moli Apa' without taking her before the police kept her hiding and on the next day she sent to America and 2/3 days after Moli Apa sent her to the police by a car. The police took her left, thumb impression on a paper. She further stated that Moli Apa used to tell her to go to the police as she was being called and she was made a witness after discussions with the police. The p.w pleaded her ignorance as to whether Tasmia was mad for Titu and whether Moli Apa wanted to have a marital tie between Titu and Tasmia. She denied the defence suggestion that as Titu did not want to marry Tasmia 'Molt Apa' in collusion with the police made Titu an accused and her a witness and that she did not give any statement to the police and the Magistrate willingly or voluntarily. She denied the further defence suggestion that Moli apa was keeping her in her (Moli apa) house by giving her all the expenses. She also denied the defence suggestion that she had fled away from the house of Shamanja for some other reasons and she deposed falsely at the instance of the police and an influential quarter. 

 28. P.W.8 is Ahmed Rad Nizam. He deposed that he was manager, marketing of Centras Maritime limited. He joined his service in the 'company in 1997. The occurrence took place on 9.6.99 at 5.15 p.m. at the place in between Band box and Chung king restaurant at Sheik- Mujib Road. Mr. Jibran was the agency manager of their office and he knew him before he joined the service. He had professional and personal relationship with Mr. Jibran. On the said date while he was doing marketing for the office Jibran telephoned him in his cell phone at about 12-00 o'clock; after completing his work he went to the residence of his father-in-law to take lunch and returned to the office at 230 P.M. Al that time Mr. Jibran was in the office and he talked to him in his chamber for about 1/2 an hour and then went to his desk. At 5.15 Mr. Jibran told him that he was leaving the office. The p.w. left the office at about 5-35/5-40 p.m. and at about 6/6-05 p.m. when he was entering into his house telephone was ringing. After he received the telephone Mr. Imtiazul Huda from the other end informed him that a telephone came to the office intimating the fact that Mr. Jibran being shot was taken to hospital. On hearing the said information he asked Imtiajul Buda to go to the hospital quickly to ascertain the fact. Thereafter, he informed his wife about the said information and keeping her in the ground floor with his sister-in-law (ভাবী) started for the hospital and on way to he received a telephone to the hospital from Rony Khan who wanted to know where was he and when he replied that he was going to the medical he asked him to go quickly saying that Jibran was no more. He further stated that after entering into the main gate of the hospital before the emergency ward when he got down from his car he saw the official car of Jibran, front glass of the car being, broken but the glass did not fell; there was no sign of hitting on the body of the car. He having found Rony Khan at the entry point of the emergency ward asked him where was Jibran and he by signal told that might be some where towards the 2nd door, then he alone walked down towards the said door and found the dead body of Jibran on a trolly with bleeding on the chest. Seeing the dead body he became frightened and came out from the said room. On his asking where was. Titli, Rony khan replied that she was in the car and then he saw Titli sitting in the right side of the car of Rony. After asking Titli twice did she know what happened, she replied that she saw dead body. When he asked Titli would he take her to the High Commission building she replied in the negative. There after, the p.w, Titli and Rony Khan went to his house and he after keeping Titli with his wife and sister-in-law in the ground floor went to the first floor and started telephoning to different persons informing them about the fact of the death of Jibran; other people also started telephoning him from out side then his wife brought Titli to the first floor. After 11/2 hour many people came to his house; some police officers also came and they interrogated the persons present in his house including himself. On query from the police they came to know that the occurrence took place in front of Band box. Police further told that while Jibran was, driving the car some people stopped the car by throwing bricks 'and then after breaking the glass of the driving seat and the side seats shot him. After the police left the house of the p.w. Salman Ispahani and his wife decided to take Titli to their house and accordingly, at about 9.30/10 p.m. they took Titli to their house. On the next day the High Commissioner's office sent the dead body of Jibran to Calcutta. Police examined him. In cross-examination the p.w. stated that he did not inform the police after getting telephone from Imtiazul. He also did not ask Rosy Khan whether the police was informed; Rony Khan also) did tell him anything. He did not inquire from Rony Khan as to whether any person from out side took Jibran to the hospital. He found the car of Jibran in abandoned condition and many people were standing out side. While Titli was taken to the house of Ispahani he did not know whether any case was filed about the killing of Jibran. He saw the glass of the car broken. He denied the defence suggestion that the glass on the left side of the front seat of the car was not broken. The p.w. further stated that he heard about the place of the occurrence from the police. When Titli was taken to his house he did not see the money bag, briefcase, mobile telephone and other personal belongings of Jibran. He came in contact with Jibran in the later part of 1995 and at that time he was married. He denied the defence suggestion that Jibran was involved with smuggling for which he had secret link with the smugglers and because of his said smuggling link some enemies were created and at their instance the false case was concocted against the accused. He further stated that he was in Bangladesh from 9.6.99 up to 14.7.99. During the said period he attended the office regularly and the D.B police examined him about the occurrence. Rony Khan was a divorcee when Jibran was killed. Titli used to serve in, Grammar school of which Mr. Ispahani was a director. This p.w denied the further the defence suggestion that he did not see Jibran in the office on the date of the occurrence and that no occurrence took place at the place in between Band box and Chung king as stated by him and that he suppressed the truth as per dictation of Rony Khan who divorced his wife because, of Titli. 

 29. P.W. 9 is Imtiazul Huda. He deposed that he toed to serve as operation executive in Centras Maritime. He joined the said post in 1995. He knew Mr. Jibran who was the agency manager in their office. Occurrence took place on 9.6.99 at 5.30 p.m. Mr. Jibran was shot at the place in between Band box and Chung king restaurant. He heard that some miscreants shot him. On the date of the occurrence at 5.25 p.m. when he was in the office a telephone call came from Jibran, which he received. Mr. Jibran asked him to give the telephone to Shadhan; he on keeping the telephone on line looked for Shadhan but he (Shadhan) not being available he inquired about the where abouts of Shadhan from Mr. Mihir and Mr. Rad Nizam who were also in the office but they mould not say anything. Thereafter, when the receiver was lifted it was found that the line was cut and immediately thereafter when Shadhan came with some official papers he informed him that Mr. Jibran was looking for him and then he dialed the cell phone of Jibran being No.011761061; though the telephone was ringing, yet, no one received the telephone. Then he telephoned at the residence of Mr. Jibran in No.620220. The telephone was received by Mrs. Jibran Tayyabi to whom he told that some time before a telephone came from Mr. Jibran and he wanted Shadhan. He further inquired from Mrs. Jibran Tayyabi whether Mr. Jibran went to the residence but she replied in the negative and told to send Shadhan to their residence. Thereafter, Mr. Rad Nizam went away. At that time Mrs. Jibran Tayyabi made a telephone call in their office which was received by him. Mrs. Jibran wanted to know who else was in the office to which he replied that besides himself, Mihir and Shadhan were in the office and then she kept the telephone. Therafter, Mihir went away and while he was arranging the papers of his table at 6.p.m, one Mr. Suman telephoned in their office in telephone No. 714604 and wanted to know whether it was the office of Mr. Jiban. In reply when the p.w. wanted to now the number at which he dialed telling that there was none in the office in the name of Jiban, Mr. Suman told him that he dialed at telephone No. 714604, then he told him that telephone number was all eight but the name was not correct. Mr. Suman told him that he had a card and then when he told Mr. Suman to see the card carefully he said that in the card the name written was Jibran Tayyabi. Then when he asked said Mr. Suman where did he get the card and where was Jibran Tayyabi, he informed him that some people shot him at the middle place in between Band box and Char King restaurant and he took him to hospital in grievously injured condition. Mr. Suman also requested him to inform the said fact to the residence of Mr. Jibran. He further stated that he wanted to know the address of Mr. Suman but he did not give him his address. Thereafter, the p.w. telephoned at the residence of Jibran and informed the said fact to Mrs. Jibran Tayyabi hearing which she broke into tears and he was also about to cry and then Mrs. Tayyabi gave the receiver to Mr. Rony Khan and when he repeated same thing to him he out emotion told to the effect; "আমি পাগল হইয়া গিয়াছি কিনা” But in reply he told him that he did not become mad rather he told what he was informed. At about 6.05 minutes the p.w. made a telephone call to the residence of Mr. Rad Nizam and gave him the message who asked him to go to the hospital immediately telling that he was also going. Thereafter on closing the office Shadhan and himself went to the house of Mihir in a short way but they having not found him there left the said message to 2 women whom they found at the residence requesting them to ask Mr. Mihir to telephone him in his mobile phone and then they started for the hospital by a baby taxi and reached the hospital at about 6.45 p.m. When he was entering into the emergency ward he came to know from some one there that Mr. Jibran already expired. Then he and Shadhan after obtaining permission from the police went inside the ward and saw the dead body of Mr. Jibran in gory condition in a small room being bullet hit. After coming out from the said ward both of them were crying. He found the car of Mr. Jibran outside the ward the front glass being fractured and the 2 side front glass of the car also being broken. He saw spot of blood on the seat and the broken glass. Thereafter, the p.w. 'again contacted Mr. Rad Nizam who told him to go to his residence saying that the police went there and then he went to the residence of Rad Nizam where he found Mrs. Jibran, Mr. Rony Khan, other people and the police. Two police officers asked him about the receipt of the telephone call and he told them in verbatim all the necessary/ informations. He saw Mrs. Jibran crying and the eyes of Mr. Roni Khan full of tears. He also started crying out of emotion and told every body present there what he knew and then again went to the medical to look for Mr. Mihir but he having not found him there went to his residence at 9 p.m.

 34. P.W.I3 is Saiful Alam. He deposed that he used to deal in motor parts. The name of his shop was String House. The shop was at 302, Sheikh Mujib Road, Agrabad.
